hardware.variant: Assembled kit; V1.2 reported by operator; ESP32-S31 silicon revision 0.0 identified through ROM

inputs.name: RAM-only ESP32-S31 SPL with NOR read probe

scenario: Start an experimental SPL in RAM, read two 4 KiB NOR ranges and compare their CRC32 values to an independently checked complete backup. Continue to OpenSBI and U-Boot in RAM.
expected: Both sampled ranges agree with the corresponding bytes in the backup, and the RAM firmware chain continues.
observed: The probe reported CRC32 70f96d2a for the 4 KiB range at offset 0x2000 and c223153e for the 4 KiB range at offset 0x20000; both match independent calculations over the backup. OpenSBI and U-Boot subsequently started.
limits: The probe was built from a modified worktree; it is not established as a byte-identical build of the published nb10 source package.
This samples two NOR ranges on one operator-reported V1.2 sample and does not verify the entire NOR address space.
This is a RAM-only read test, not a persistent installation, NOR write, restore or cold boot.
The trace and device identifiers remain private; no raw logs or identifiers are published.
